entities.name: Q04V47
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (367 aa) to reviewed Leptospira borgpetersenii peptide chain release factor 2; annotated to terminate translation at UGA and UAA stop codons.
Sequence scan detects PCRF domain PF03462 at residues 34–222 and RF-1 domain PF00472 at residues 230–340.
Curated reference annotation places the protein in the cytoplasm and assigns codon-specific translation release factor activity.
